posts.title: Anger
posts.description: This post in my "stages of grief" series is long overdue. Anyways, most of the anger, if I'm honest, is pointed at myself. It's the natural next step after denial — I can only blame the field for moving without me for so long before I notice you're the one who refused the map. But not all of it.
